title: central-monitoring-hub configure-module input
description: Validates module-wide FQDN, TLS, TSDB/Loki retention, Restic backup mode, local vs S3/Thanos storage backend, and NS8 LDAP/AD admin SSO settings.

host.description: Public/internal FQDN registered in NS8 Traefik for Grafana UI and HTTPS telemetry ingest.

lets_encrypt.description: Request an automatic Let's Encrypt ACME certificate in NS8 Traefik.

http2https.description: Redirect plain HTTP requests to HTTPS in NS8 Traefik.

retention_days.description: Local Prometheus TSDB retention period in days (in s3 mode, local hot cache retention while Thanos serves long-term blocks from S3).

retention_size_gb.description: Maximum local Prometheus TSDB disk usage in GiB (0 disables size-based pruning).

loki_retention_days.description: Loki compactor log retention period in days.

backup_include_tsdb.description: When false (default), NS8 Restic backs up configs, tenants, tokens, rules, silences, and online SQLite grafana.db dump only; when true, raw prometheus-data and loki-data volumes are also included.

storage_mode.description: Storage backend mode: 'local' (Podman volumes only) or 's3' (native Loki S3 TSDB + Thanos Sidecar/Store/Query).

endpoint.description: S3/MinIO host[:port] without scheme (e.g. s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com or minio.lan:9000).

bucket.description: Target S3 bucket name for Loki chunks/index and Thanos TSDB blocks.

secret_key.description: S3 secret access key. May be omitted/empty when secret_key_unchanged is true.

secret_key_unchanged.description: Preserve previously stored S3 secret key when updating other settings.

insecure.description: Use plain HTTP instead of HTTPS when talking to an internal S3/MinIO endpoint.

path_style.description: Use path-style S3 addressing (required for most MinIO/Ceph deployments).

ldap_enabled.description: Enable NS8 LDAP / Active Directory login for MSP technicians into Grafana Main Org (Org 1).

ldap_domain.description: NS8 user domain name discovered via agent.ldapproxy.Ldapproxy.

ldap_admin_group.description: LDAP/AD group short CN or full Distinguished Name mapped to Grafana Org 1 Admin role.

ldap_editor_group.description: Optional LDAP/AD group short CN or full Distinguished Name mapped to Grafana Org 1 Editor role.

ldap_viewer_group.description: Optional LDAP/AD group short CN or full Distinguished Name mapped to Grafana Org 1 Viewer role.

ldap_admin_principals.description: Multi-select LDAP/AD group or user DNs/names mapped to Grafana Org 1 Admin role.

ldap_editor_principals.description: Multi-select LDAP/AD group or user DNs/names mapped to Grafana Org 1 Editor role.

ldap_viewer_principals.description: Multi-select LDAP/AD group or user DNs/names mapped to Grafana Org 1 Viewer role.

grafana_admin_password.description: New local Grafana Org 1 admin password (min 8 chars when non-empty; empty string keeps current password).
